hint.zh: 已知的圆点在右边，目标的圆点在左边。
hint.en: A given’s dot is on its right; the goal’s dot is on its left.

t.zh: 基本命题每多一个，真值表的行数就翻一倍。证明器的新模块<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>换一种办法：从前提出发，按<wiki-ref to="rule"></wiki-ref>一步步推出结论。
t.en: Each extra atom doubles the rows of a truth table. The prover’s new module, the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>, works another way: from premises to a conclusion, one <wiki-ref to="rule"></wiki-ref> at a time.

t.zh: 板左边的已知是前提，右边的目标是要证的命题。一根线传的是一句已经证出的话。
t.en: The givens on the left are the premises; the goal on the right is the proposition to prove. A wire carries a sentence already proved.

t.zh: 下方的测试把同一个命题模式里的字母换成不同的句子，最后一个就是字母本身。同一块电路要通过每一个测试。
t.en: The tests below put different sentences in place of the letters of one pattern, the last being the letters themselves. One board must pass them all.
